designationHistory.designation: National Wildlife Refuge and Management Area
designationHistory.indexText: The Patoka River National Wildlife Refuge and Management Area in southwestern Indiana was established under the Emergency Wetlands Resources Act through a Record of Decision signed by Regional Director Sam Marler.

authority.citation: Record of Decision under the Emergency Wetlands Resources Act of 1986

designationHistory.note: FWS sources disagree on the day (September 7 vs. September 8, 1994).

sources.name: FWS ServCat: Compatibility Determination, Patoka River NWR (1996): established September 7, 1994
FWS ServCat: Patoka River NWR Compatibility Determination, Hunting (2020): established September 8, 1994
